name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 8 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-11-24, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
